architecturally_expressible.meaning: The producer and SA inport selectors can both remain on physical source/buffer0, and the normal buffer manager has clear/reuse and backpressure machinery for serialized single-buffer operation.
architecturally_expressible.claim_boundary: Expressibility is not equivalence to the materialized node0004 schedule.

equivalent_to_current_node0004.first_counterexample: On the first accepted source0 tag with last=1 and last_index=4, matched ping-pong suppresses the outgoing logical terminal and advances to source1; both-off propagates the terminal immediately and stays on source0.
equivalent_to_current_node0004.global_all_ingress_counterexample: The current B path is materialized as fixed stream1 to physical buffer2 plus fixed stream2 to physical buffer3 while SA inport1 ping-pongs between them. Disabling SA inport1 without rebuilding the B producers strands buffer3 and consumes only buffer2.

currently_proven_correct.reason: No fresh both-off JSON/mapping/bitstream/execplan/SCA/address/lifetime/terminal/local-E2 proof exists, and the current schedule has a deterministic tag/selector difference.

rtl_evidence.claim: The selected source drives tag/data/backpressure; ping-pong off permanently selects source0.
Matched ping-pong emits logical last only on source1, while off mode emits source0 last directly.
Only enabled ping-pong can toggle the consumer selector at the accepted terminal boundary.
Backpressure, valid hold, address update, lifetime clear, and buffer clear make a serialized single-buffer schedule architecturally possible.

proves: off mode propagates the first source0 terminal while matched mode suppresses it
after acceptance off stays on source0 while matched mode advances to source1
focused_counterexample.does_not_prove: It does not claim that no independently rebuilt serialized single-buffer node0004 schedule can ever be correct.
